items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: I know him in Helen, Arkansas.

ctx.x: Oh, I was raised up in Memphis. Been here all of my life.
But where did you know Roosevelt Sykes?
I know him in Helen, Arkansas. I traveled back in the fall. I wouldn't travel very far. I was in Arkansas and different states like that.

items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: I started him off on piano.

ctx.x: Roosevelt Sax. I know him, too. I started him off on piano. Do it call in Hell, Arkansas.
